title: Projects map
loadFailedTitle: The map could not be opened
loadFailedBody: Check your internet connection and try again. The project list works without the map.
noWebgl: This device cannot display the map. Use the project list to reach the data.
basemapOffline: No base map for this area while offline; projects are still shown. Download a map pack for field work.
basemapUnavailable: The base map could not be loaded; projects are still shown.
legendPending: Saved on this device, not uploaded
locateUnsupported: Location is not supported on this device.
locateDenied: Location access was not allowed. Allow location for this app in the browser settings.
locateUnavailable: Your location cannot be found right now. Try in an open place.
locateTimeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again.
notOnDevice: This project is not stored on your device; its details open when you are online.
pickTitle: Choose the location on the map
pickHint: Tap the map where the project is.
pickDiscardBody: You chose a new location but did not confirm it. Return without changing the location?
packsIntro: Download the map of your area so the base map shows in remote villages without internet. Each pack's size is shown before downloading, and an interrupted download resumes.
packsEmpty: No map packs have been published yet. Packs are added by the administration.
packDeleteBody: The pack “{name}” will be removed from this device, freeing {size}. You can download it again later.
packInstalled: The pack “{name}” is ready for offline use.
packError_offline: No internet connection. Try again when you are back online.
packError_storage_full: There is not enough space on this device for this pack.
packError_http: The server refused the download. Try again later.
packError_range_unsupported: The server does not support partial downloads for this pack.
packError_changed: The pack changed on the server during the download. Download it again.
packError_short_read: Part of the file arrived incomplete. Press “Resume download”.
packError_integrity: The file failed the integrity check and was deleted. Download it again.
packError_network: The connection dropped during the download. What arrived is kept; press “Resume download”.
